# Marks in their typed order

A link around bold: [**the docs**](https://example.com/docs) here.

Bold around a link: **[the docs](https://example.com/docs)** here.

- ~~[https://example.com/old](https://example.com/old)~~

**1.**[**https://example.com/a**](https://example.com/a) and more.

Strong inside strong: **__twice__**, emphasis inside emphasis: *a _b_ c*.
